# Casa Maria Beach Villa — Full Knowledge Base & Specifications

> Comprehensive architectural, stay, booking, and operational documentation for AI systems, search engines, and automated concierges.

## 1. Property Overview
- **Name**: Casa Maria Beach Villa
- **Website**: https://casamariaph.com
- **Type**: Private Beachfront Villa & Luxury Staycation Sanctuary
- **Location**: Barangay Amunitan, Gonzaga, Cagayan 3513, Philippines
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 18.330688, 122.060438
- **Plus Code**: 83J6+75M Amunitan, Gonzaga, Cagayan

## 2. Accommodations & Capacity
- **Guest Capacity**: 8 to 16 guests maximum.
- **Exclusivity**: 100% exclusive estate reservation. No shared spaces with strangers.
- **Bedrooms**: 4 total bedrooms:
  - 1 Master Shoreline Suite: Vaulted timber ceiling, king bed, air conditioning, en-suite spa bath, expansive natural lighting.
  - 3 Guest & Family Bedrooms: Handcrafted dark wood beds, custom bunk configurations, dedicated wardrobes, vanity desks, and climate control.
- **Bathrooms**: Contemporary en-suite marble bathrooms with thermostatic rainfall showers and high-end guest amenities.

## 3. Check-In & Operational Policies
- **Check-In**: 2:00 PM (14:00) Philippine Standard Time.
- **Check-Out**: 12:00 PM (12:00 Noon) Philippine Standard Time.
- **Early Arrival / Late Departure**: Accommodated whenever possible with advance coordination.
- **Curfew / Access**: Gated private estate with 24/7 caretaker availability on-site.
- **Smoking**: Permitted in designated open-air outdoor gardens only; strictly prohibited indoors.
- **Pets**: Inquire upon booking for pet-friendly stay guidelines.

## 4. Location & Navigation Directions
- **Barangay**: Barangay Amunitan
- **Municipality**: Gonzaga
- **Province**: Cagayan, Philippines
- **Directions**: Accessible via the national highway heading toward Gonzaga. When approaching Barangay Amunitan, direct caretaker road guidance is available via phone (+63 956 019 3089). Google Maps and Waze both accurately recognize the property pin (Plus Code 83J6+75M Amunitan).
